name: Harbor
css:
/* New-thread hero: Monocode's dither, rendered at 1 CSS px per cell.
   The composer stack holds a headline only on the new-thread page, with or
   without a project; there is no data attribute for that state.
   ::before is the dither mask: color-dodge pushes the peak map to 0.96 where
   it beats the Bayer threshold, and the filter turns that into 0 or 0.55.
   ::after multiplies in the full-brightness colors. */
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) {
  --harbor-peak: url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --harbor-color: url("data:image/webp;base64,");
  --harbor-bayer: url("data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgoAAAANSUhEUgAAAAgAAAAICAAAAADhZOFXAAAAMElEQVR42mP8zlDNkMxQw8DEAAUsFgytDJYMrUgi0xiqGW4wVCNEGBkYmhjmIqsBAE1zB+fGIpMJAAAAAElFTkSuQmCC");
  --harbor-fade: linear-gradient(to bottom, rgb(0 0 0 / 1) 0%, rgb(0 0 0 / 1) 19%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.79) 30%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.5) 42%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.2) 54%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05) 64%, rgb(0 0 0 / 0) 72%);
  position: relative;
  isolation: isolate;
  background: #0b1018 !important;
}
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1)::before,
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1)::after {
  content: "";
  position: absolute;
  inset: 0;
  z-index: -1;
  pointer-events: none;
  -webkit-mask-image: var(--harbor-fade);
  mask-image: var(--harbor-fade);
}
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1)::before {
  background: var(--harbor-bayer) 0 0 / 4px 4px repeat, var(--harbor-peak) center top / cover no-repeat;
  background-blend-mode: color-dodge, normal;
  filter: brightness(0.53) contrast(1000) brightness(0.55);
}
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1)::after {
  background: var(--harbor-color) center top / cover no-repeat;
  mix-blend-mode: multiply;
}
/* Light mode matches Monocode: full-brightness dots at 50% over the page. */
:root:not(.dark) [data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) {
  background: #f5f7fa !important;
}
:root:not(.dark) [data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1)::before {
  filter: brightness(0.53) contrast(1000);
}
:root:not(.dark) [data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1)::before,
:root:not(.dark) [data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1)::after {
  opacity: 0.5;
}

/* Several wrappers between the column and the hero paint bg-background. */
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) [data-chat-header],
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) .bg-background {
  background: transparent !important;
}
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) [data-chat-header],
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) [data-chat-composer-stack] > :has(h1) {
  text-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.75);
}
:root:not(.dark) [data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) [data-chat-header],
:root:not(.dark) [data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) [data-chat-composer-stack] > :has(h1) {
  text-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8);
}

/* The footer row under the composer is a full-width glass strip; its blur
   flattens the dither into a dark band, so it floats on the artwork. */
[data-chat-column]:has([data-chat-composer-stack] h1) [data-slot="composer-context-strip"] {
  background: none !important;
  -webkit-backdrop-filter: none !important;
  backdrop-filter: none !important;
}

/* Conversations: harbor.jpg behind the chat. The canvas color laid over it
   keeps message text readable; the new-thread hero above stays opaque. */
[data-workspace-area="conversation"] {
  background: linear-gradient(rgb(11 16 24 / 0.82), rgb(11 16 24 / 0.82)), var(--theme-background-image) center / cover no-repeat;
}
:root:not(.dark) [data-workspace-area="conversation"] {
  background: linear-gradient(rgb(245 247 250 / 0.86), rgb(245 247 250 / 0.86)), var(--theme-background-image) center / cover no-repeat;
}
